parsed.why: No trans criminalisation, but official calls to exile trans people, no hate-crime or anti-discrimination recourse, courts endorsing gay-panic defences, and a documented assault on an LGBT visitor. Dated anti-LGB violence with impunity.

New code criminalises all same-sex conduct; presidential decree frames LGBTQ as national-defence threats; vigilante mobs attack trans women; police raids; a trans traveller died in custody. Organised targeting plus state threat-framing.

No criminalisation and gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime law, but weak enforcement: unsanctioned police assault/torture probe, LGBT centre closed after 20+ unsanctioned attacks, violent pride history, documented rule-of-law weakness.

Decriminalised 2022 and court read sex discrimination to cover gender identity, but no statutory protections and no marker change; violence axis undocumented, one dated assault. Thin record, no documented official hostility.

No criminalisation; courts and self-ID framework protect trans people; but frequent street harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities and rising top-level anti-LGBT hostility from the head of government.
